speaker: Sheldon
text: Not yet, but her underwater photo shoot was an embarrassment. There's the host. Free swim. Free swim.

speaker: Howard
text: Sadly, Mrs. Giselle Wolowitz is sensitive to chlorine. Lucky for her, I like my fashion models pruney and bug-eyed. Shout in foods here. Why? Isn't it obvious? Every week they kick out a beautiful girl, making her feel unwanted and without self-esteem.

speaker: Leonard
text: Did I miss anything? Did they kick Giselle off? What are you doing?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Marking the stop positions and physical landmarks so we can find the house of the supermodels.

speaker: Howard
text: AKA the future Mrs. Howard Wolowitz.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Here's my hamburger, medium well. Dill slices, not sweet. Individual relish packets. Onion rings. Extra breading.

speaker: Leonard
text: I asked.

speaker: Sheldon
text: What did they say? Did you protest? Vociferously? Well, then what took you so long?

speaker: Leonard
text: Just eat.

speaker: Howard
text: Giselle's hanging by a thread.

speaker: Penny
text: Hey guys, what'd I miss? What'd I miss? Oh, good, I hate her.

speaker: Howard
text: Then you're not invited to our wedding.

speaker: Leonard
text: There you go.

speaker: Penny
text: Thank you.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, do we have to suffer through this transparently manipulative pseudo-reality again? You and I have a standing TV schedule, which is the result of extensive debate and compromise. Any alterations, except for breaking news, have to be pre-approved at the weekly roommate meeting.

speaker: Penny
text: Yes.

speaker: Leonard
text: Put it on the agenda.

text: You have to make a motion to put it on the agenda.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'll make a motion, but you're not gonna like it.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Fine. Mock parliamentary procedure. At least put it on mute.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh. Giselle's not getting kicked off. It's totally gonna be summer.
